description: This file defines the 'PrepareBodyMiddleware' class in the GuzzleHttp namespace. It prepares HTTP requests with a body by adding appropriate headers such as Content-Length, Content-Type, and Expect. The class is designed to work as middleware in the Guzzle HTTP client to modify requests before they are sent.

classes.name: PrepareBodyMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class for preparing HTTP requests with a body by adding necessary headers and considering request size and protocol version.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a callable '$nextHandler' to invoke the next middleware or request handler.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, adding headers such as Content-Type, Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding, and Expect based on the request properties and options.

methods.name: addExpectHeader
methods.description: Private method to determine whether to add an 'Expect: 100-Continue' header based on request and options.
